description: A fire department employs regular and emergency fire fighters. A regular fire fighter works 10 hours per shift and earns $300. An emergency fire fighter works 6 hours per shift and earns $100. Due to wildfires in the region, the fire department needs at least 300 hours of fire fighter time. If the fire department has a budget of $7000, how many of each should the fire department hire to minimize the total number of fire fighters?

HoursPerShift.definition: Amount of hours each fire fighter type works per shift

CostPerShift.definition: Cost of each fire fighter type per shift

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of fire fighters hired (regular and emergency combined)"

constraints.description: The total fire fighter hours provided must be at least 300 hours
The total cost of hiring fire fighters must not exceed the $7000 budget
The number of regular and emergency fire fighters hired must be greater than or equal to 0
The number of regular and emergency fire fighters hired must be integers
